title: 100+ components, blocks, AI interfaces and charts
summary: vuelix grows from 15 to 114 items across four sections: Components, Blocks, AI and Charts.
items: Components: inputs and pickers (select, combobox, multi-select, date range, wheel, dial, color picker, sliders), overlays (popover, context menu, drawer, bottom sheet, expanding modal), navigation, layout, data display and motion utilities
Blocks: command palette, dynamic island, morphing search, action bar, notification center, file dropzone, auth form, token swap, wallet card, card fan, radial menu, 404 and more
AI: chat app, chat message and scroller, prompt input, streaming text, tool calls, approvals, file diffs, citations, agent activity, voice orb and model picker
Charts: line, bar, donut, funnel, treemap, sankey, candlestick, order book, heat calendar, stacked area, forecast fan and more, all hand-rolled SVG with no chart library
Cross-component imports now use @/components/ui/<name>, so items with dependencies resolve after a CLI install

title: vuelix is live
summary: Animated, copy-paste components for Vue 3 & Nuxt, built on Tailwind CSS v4 and motion-v.
items: 15 components across buttons, inputs, overlays, navigation, surfaces, text, feedback and charts
shadcn-vue compatible registry: npx shadcn-vue add https://vuelix.dev/r/<name>.json
The vuelix npm package with tree-shakeable ESM, types and a one-line Tailwind setup
Agent-friendly endpoints: llms.txt, /r catalogue, raw sources and an MCP server at /mcp
Docs at vuelix.dev with live previews, light and dark themes
